mara/hb-01-salt.intro.0.prompt: [warm, brisk] You'll be the new tenant, then. Bait shop's yours till somebody says otherwise.

mara/hb-01-salt.intro.1.prompt: [warm, unhurried] Rod's on the hook by the door. Your aunt's, it was. Go on, end of the dock.

mara/hb-01-salt.intro.2.prompt: [brisk, matter-of-fact] Hold to cast, let go in the bright bit. Bring me three fish and I'll show you how we do things.

mara/hb-01-salt.reminder.prompt: [warm, teasing] Three fish, love. End of the dock. I'll be right here, pretending not to watch.

mara/hb-01-salt.outro.0.prompt: [pleased] Three! And none of them looking at you funny. Good start.

mara/hb-01-salt.outro.1.prompt: [warm, brisk] I'll buy what you catch, right here at the stall. Fair prices. [dryly] Mostly fair.

mara/hb-02-supper.intro.0.prompt: [warm, concerned] Half the village eats what comes off this dock. Lately it's been… thin.

mara/hb-02-supper.intro.1.prompt: [brisk] Sell me eight fish. The bigger the better. [wry] The odder the better, honestly.

mara/hb-02-supper.reminder.prompt: [warm, brisk] Eight fish for the stall. Bring them here and I'll do the sums.

mara/hb-02-supper.outro.0.prompt: [pleased, warm] That'll feed the Pollards and then some. Here, you've earned a look at the good shelf.

mara/hb-02-supper.outro.1.prompt: [brisk] And the notice board by the stall's got odd jobs, if you want more coin. Folk pay well for strange requests.

mara/hb-03-proper-rod.intro.0.prompt: [dry, amused] That driftwood stick will snap the first time something with opinions bites.

mara/hb-03-proper-rod.intro.1.prompt: [brisk, businesslike] Harbour Rod. Four hundred and fifty. I'll even throw in some worms.

mara/hb-03-proper-rod.reminder.prompt: [brisk] Harbour Rod's on the good shelf. Four-fifty. I don't haggle. [dryly] Much.

mara/hb-03-proper-rod.outro.0.prompt: [approving] Now you look like you mean it. Worms are in the tin. Don't open it indoors.

wick/hb-04-drawing.intro.0.prompt: [conspiratorial, quick, sure of himself] Look! I drew it before I saw it. That means it's real. That's how it works.

wick/hb-04-drawing.intro.1.prompt: [quick, earnest, a little breathless] It's pink and it bites sunsets. It lives near the cove or the Teeth. [hopeful] Catch it? Please?

wick/hb-04-drawing.reminder.prompt: [eager, quick, matter-of-fact] The pink one! Near the cove or the Teeth. It likes sunsets best.

wick/hb-04-drawing.outro.0.prompt: [conspiratorial, quick, amazed] It looks EXACTLY like my drawing! Except it has fewer legs. [matter-of-fact] I'll fix that.

pell/hb-05-dark-lamp.intro.0.prompt: [slow, low, grave] The light on Gull Point's been dark since the keeper went down. [pointed] Down, I said. Not away.

pell/hb-05-dark-lamp.intro.1.prompt: [slow, low] A lamp like that won't take ordinary oil. It wants a light the sea made.

pell/hb-05-dark-lamp.intro.2.prompt: [slow, quiet] Lampjaw. After the sun's gone. Bring me one.

pell/hb-05-dark-lamp.reminder.prompt: [slow, dry] Lampjaw only shows once the sun's gone. Be patient. The sea is.

pell/hb-05-dark-lamp.outro.0.prompt: [slow, soft, satisfied] There. Still warm. Hold onto it, it'll want to go home.

pell/hb-06-relight.intro.0.prompt: [slow, steady] Up the stairs, all the way. Put the light where the light goes.

pell/hb-06-relight.intro.1.prompt: [slow, low, warning] And when it catches, don't look at the water. Not straight away.

pell/hb-06-relight.reminder.prompt: [slow, gentle, unhurried] I'll row you out to Gull Point when you're ready. Just say.

pell/hb-06-relight.outro.0.prompt: [slow, quiet, moved] There she is. Hearthbay's been holding its breath a long while.

pell/hb-06-relight.outro.1.prompt: [slow, low, knowing] You saw it, didn't you. In the water. Two of them.

pell/hb-06-relight.outro.2.prompt: [slow, dry, gentle] Good. Then you're the keeper now. Nobody chooses it. Take the skiff, it was hers.

pell/hb-07-kettle.intro.0.prompt: [slow, steady, instructive] She's light on the helm. Push her on and she goes, let her be and she glides. Never cast till she's settled.

pell/hb-07-kettle.intro.1.prompt: [slow, low, fond] South-west of here there's an isle with a kettle on it. The keeper took her tea there, tides she wanted quiet.

pell/hb-07-kettle.intro.2.prompt: [slow, low, uneasy] Go and see if it's still warm. It will be. That's the part I don't care for.

pell/hb-07-kettle.reminder.prompt: [slow, dry] Kettle Isle. West of the cove, out past its mouth. You'll know the beach.

pell/hb-07-kettle.outro.0.prompt: [slow, low, grave] Warm, was it. Twelve winters on a bare rock, and warm.

pell/hb-07-kettle.outro.1.prompt: [slow, gentle, unhurried] Keep it. Her things go to whoever keeps the light.

mara/hb-08-teeth.intro.0.prompt: [warm, brisk] So he's given you the skiff. Good. It's sat at that dock like a held breath.

mara/hb-08-teeth.intro.1.prompt: [warm, concerned] South-west there's three black rocks, the Teeth. Deep water. Nothing off them has reached my stall in a long while.

mara/hb-08-teeth.intro.2.prompt: [brisk] Bring me a Twofold Flounder. [dryly] And don't let it look at you with both faces at once.

mara/hb-08-teeth.reminder.prompt: [warm, matter-of-fact] The Teeth, south-west past the sandbar. Flounder sit deep, so give it line.

mara/hb-08-teeth.outro.0.prompt: [warm, approving] Oh, that's the one. Look at it. [wary] Looking at us.

mara/hb-08-teeth.outro.1.prompt: [warm, fond] My sister brought these in by the basket. [puzzled, unsettled] I don't know why I said that. I haven't got a sister.

mara/bark.0.prompt: [warm, brisk] Tide's kind today. Don't waste it talking to me.

mara/bark.1.prompt: [warm, wry] Butterperch fry up lovely. Not that I'd know. I'm far too busy.

mara/bark.2.prompt: [serious, firm] If you see a light out past the Teeth, don't row toward it. Just… don't.

mara/bark.3.prompt: [warm, fond] Your rod's older than you are. Treat it gently.

wick/bark.0.prompt: [eager, quick, matter-of-fact] I'm drawing a fish with nine eyes. No, ten. It keeps changing.

wick/bark.1.prompt: [quick, matter-of-fact, a bit sulky] Biscuit ate my blue crayon. Now everything's a bit green.

wick/bark.2.prompt: [excited, conspiratorial] Did you know fish dream? I asked one. It said yes.

pell/bark.0.prompt: [very slow, dry, faintly amused] High water at a quarter past never. Low water just after you've forgotten.

pell/bark.1.prompt: [slow, dry] The lamp remembers. That's the trouble with lamps.

pell/bark.2.prompt: [slow, gentle, dryly amused] Mind the second moon. It minds you.
